subject: [PATCH 34/60] mm/mempolicy: don't rebind policies onto private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted a follow-up reply with additional context and code changes to address potential issues.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses rebinding policies onto private nodes in the Linux kernel's memory policy subsystem. It ensures that policies are rebound over non-private nodes and maintains the remap base, preventing policies from being moved onto newly added or removed private nodes.
